appLeftovers.title: App Leftovers
appLeftovers.description: Locate and remove app leftovers even if the main app is already gone.

backgroundItems.title: Background Items
backgroundItems.description: Manage background apps and processes running on your Mac.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: Review and clean one-time use files from Downloads to keep folders tidy.

largeOld.title: Large and Old Files
largeOld.description: Find and remove large, unused files that take up space on your Mac.

similarImages.title: Similar Images
similarImages.description: Review similar photos and keep only the best ones.

trashBins.title: Trash Bins
trashBins.description: Empty all of the available Trash Bins on your Mac.

duplicateFinder.title: Duplicate Finder
duplicateFinder.description: Remove duplicate files stored in different locations on your Mac.

applicationPermissions.title: Application Permissions
applicationPermissions.description: Manage how apps access system features, devices, and functionality.

systemJunk.title: System Junk
systemJunk.description: Remove redundant files that clog up device storage and impede optimal performance.

timeMachineSnapshot.title: Time Machine Snapshot
timeMachineSnapshot.description: Remove local Time Machine snapshots without affecting your backups.

loginItems.title: Login Items
loginItems.description: Manage apps that open automatically when you start your Mac.

mailAttachments.title: Mail Attachments
mailAttachments.description: Remove locally stored email attachments to free space while keeping modified files.

malwareFinder.title: Malware Finder
malwareFinder.description: Identify and remove malicious items to keep your Mac secure.

uninstaller.title: Uninstaller
uninstaller.description: Correctly remove entire applications with all of the related files.

userCache.name: User Cache Files
userCache.description: Originally intended to improve startup times, the cache files of your applications ultimately accumulate and result in improper functioning or an overall performance drop.

userLogs.name: User Log Files
userLogs.description: Log files are created by macOS and its applications to record events and errors. Over time they can grow large and take up significant space.

languageFiles.name: Language Files
languageFiles.description: Unused localization resources bundled with apps. Removing languages you do not use frees up storage without affecting functionality.

systemLogs.name: System Log Files
systemLogs.description: System-wide log files written by macOS services and daemons. These files are safe to remove as the system re-creates them when needed.

brokenLoginItems.name: Broken Login Items
brokenLoginItems.description: Login items that point to applications or files that no longer exist on your disk. Removing them speeds up login time.
